about: Gold stance pairs, labelled by hand with the reason, not by any model: does this headline agree with the claim, disagree with it (same event, both cannot be true), or say nothing about it (unrelated: another event, or not enough said)? Written in the style of real Indian headlines to cover the cases where models fail: attribution, forecasts, bounds, other entities, negation, units, interim figures, debunks, questions, time order, and Tamil and Hindi claims against English headlines. Used to judge a candidate stance model independently of Gemini (eval/stanceCandidate.js). Pairs marked trainedPattern follow a pattern the synthetic training data (ml/src/synth.py g_hedged) was written from; they are reported apart from the rest, which test generalisation.
